mechanics.claim: Only damaging basic attacks and abilities apply stacks of Spirit Abjuration.
mechanics.quote: '''Aurora's''' damaging {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Spirit Abjuration'' to enemies

mechanics.claim: The third stack consumes all stacks and deals the bonus damage as a separate instance.
mechanics.quote: The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: Runaan's Hurricane bolts apply stacks but other on-hit effects like Guinsoo's Rageblade do not.
mechanics.quote: {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}} bolts are also empowered to apply stacks (while other effects that apply {{tip|on-hit|on-hits}}, like {{ii|Guinsoo's Rageblade}}, are not).

mechanics.claim: Exorcism (heal-over-time from spirits) only occurs when the consumed target was a champion, not against a dummy/monster in general.
mechanics.quote: Upon consuming the stacks from a {{tip|champion}}, '''Aurora''' additionally exorcises them

mechanics.claim: Each active spirit heals Aurora every second; subsequent exorcisms refresh all active spirits.
mechanics.quote: For each active {{as|Spirit|buzzword}}, '''Aurora''' is {{tip|heal|healed}} for {{pplevel|2 + x|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 2% AP)}} every second.
